name: Lip plumping device
lead: A lip plumping device is a small cup or suction tool placed over the lips to draw blood and fluid into the tissue, producing a temporary swelling. Some versions add vibration or heat.
It is a do-it-yourself alternative to lip filler for a fuller look for a few hours.

paras: Negative pressure pulls blood into the lip tissue and causes mild swelling and engorgement. No new tissue is created, so the effect fades quickly.

Too much suction can cause bruising, broken capillaries, pain or swelling, and results are short-lived. I found no peer-reviewed study of suction lip devices, only patents. The scholarly source listed concerns hyaluronic acid filler, which is a different intervention, and is included as the nearest research on lip enhancement safety.

studies.title: Lip Enhancement and Perioral Area Correction With New Hyaluronic Acid Dermal Fillers: A Prospective Safety Study
